fusions.name: Picked Out From Afar
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy at or below 30% health up to 9 tiles away for 26 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Lidless Shackle
fusions.desc: Casts a shackle at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Far as It Sees
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Never Out of View
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
